notes.title: Easter Bunny Release
notes.content:
Easter is a great holiday that is loved by both children and adults. It is filled with kindness, fun and a special feeling that magic can be real. 

Today, our team presents you a game dedicated to this wonderful day - the Easter Bunny. This is a stealth action arcade game with a top-down view, where you play the role of the main figure of this event - a bunny who hides Easter eggs.

We sincerely hope that you will enjoy our game, in which we put all our love for Easter.

Always yours, SMT ent.
